description: This Java source file defines the StateConversionValidator class, which implements Spring's Validator interface to provide validation logic for ConceptStateConversion objects within the OpenMRS project. It ensures that critical fields are non-null and non-whitespace.

classes.name: StateConversionValidator
classes.description: A validator class for ConceptStateConversion objects, checking for null and empty field values.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Returns true if the provided class is ConceptStateConversion, indicating that this validator supports validating instances of that class.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on the given object, checking that concept, programWorkflow, and programWorkflowState are not null or empty. It logs a debug message if the object is null and registers errors accordingly.
